subject: Fixed regression which broke Ninja builds OO (#494)
reason: The change modifies only build.sh in valkey-search: it moves the Ninja/make build-tool selection after the function definitions and fixes ninja vs ninja-build detection so Ninja builds work again. It is purely a build-script/CI fix with no change to any module source, command behavior, reply, indexing, replication or persistence path, so there is no runtime behavior difference between the two builds for a scenario to detect.
